Hi Support Team,

I am filing a formal *complaint* regarding my Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
(Model: SM-S938B).

The physical hardware is fine, but the Bluetooth is *not working* properly
due to a frustrating *software* *glitch*. It connects to my earbuds but
then immediately *disconnects* every single time.

I don't want to send this in for a physical repair. I just need you to send
me the official manual steps to reset the network *settings* or clear the
Bluetooth cache so I can fix this software bug myself.

Please send those troubleshooting steps immediately.

Thank you, Shubham Customer ID: CUST10001 Purchase Date: 2026-02-15
